scientific_integrity: The theorem is symbolic for arbitrary world counts, with a standalone finite checker only for small sizes. Related existing results and independent-audit limits are explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Uniformly counted one-agent, labelled, nonempty, valuation-free, factive and fully introspective inquisitive frames only. Underlying S5 issue decomposition and OEIS A006126 block weights are established; probabilistic asymptotics rely on the classical Dedekind bound. Historical uniqueness beyond inspected sources is not guaranteed.
title: Almost all finite inquisitive epistemic frames have one information cell: a sharp first-defect asymptotic
